FIELDS.NAME: Reliable Building Supplies
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Reliable Building Supplies operates as a wholesale distributor of construction materials, focusing on providing a diverse range of products including lumber, drywall, roofing materials, and insulation to contractors and businesses in the construction industry. Our facility emphasizes safety and security, featuring fire prevention measures and proper inventory management systems to safeguard our high-value products. We maintain compliance with local, state, and federal regulations governing the storage and transportation of building materials, ensuring operational integrity and legal adherence. Our delivery fleet is equipped with documented security protocols, enhancing the safety of materials during transit. By fostering strong relationships with suppliers, we guarantee timely deliveries and maintain a steady inventory to meet customer demands effectively. Our commitment to ongoing safety audits and employee training reflects our proactive approach to risk management, positioning us as a reliable partner in the building materials sector.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in repair, maintenance, or installation services and confirms that all facilities have documented fire prevention measures in place for all combustible inventory. Additionally, we ensure that any outdoor storage of untreated lumber is appropriately separated from buildings, protected by firebreaks, and equipped with adequate fencing, lighting, and surveillance.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Reliable Construction Solutions, LLC - Wholesale Distributor of Renovation Supplies
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a mild warehouse fire caused by an electrical malfunction resulted in damage to inventory, leading to a loss of $5,000. The incident has been resolved, and all necessary fire prevention measures are now in place.
